min_standing_note.value: Must be nominated by partner university (cannot transfer to Wellesley); women's college gender policy considers applicants who consistently live and identify as women (cisgender, trans, and nonbinary students who consistently live and identify as women).
min_standing_note.notes: Partner nomination requirement and non-transfer status stated on 2026-2027 Factsheet page 1 and https://www.wellesley.edu/interstudy/exchange/incoming.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: University-wide UG exchange agreement (Fall/Spring); note Wellesley women's college gender policy in citizenship_restrictions.

eligible_majors.notes: Open across 55 majors (~1,000+ courses) EXCEPT Computer Science.

excluded_majors.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 3 explicitly states: 'Exchange students are NOT eligible to enroll in Computer Science courses.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must submit proof of English proficiency: TOEFL score of 100 or equivalent on a comparable test.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall 2026: Arrival Aug 21, 2026; Classes Aug 31 – Dec 9, 2026; End of exam period Dec 17, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring 2027: Arrival mid-January (TBA); Classes Jan 25 – May 5, 2027; End of exam period May 13, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 2 states: 'Tuition: Exchange students continue to pay regular tuition to their home institution.'

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Wellesley 2026-2027 SFS budget lists Academic Year Housing ($12,020) + Meals ($11,186) + Books ($800) + Personal Expenses ($1,250) = $25,256/year ($12,628/semester), prorated across a 5-month semester = $2,525.60 USD/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: ($12,020 housing + $11,186 meals + $800 books + $1,250 personal) / 2 semesters = $12,628.00 USD/semester ($2,525.60 USD/month * 5 months * 1.0 = $12,628 USD, 1 USD = 1.0 USD, checked 2026-11-15).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Student Activity Fee ($360/year per SFS), Wellesley meal plan, automatic Wellesley Student Health Insurance Plan (unless waived with US-based MA/J-1 compliant plan), and Health History & Immunization Form.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: SFS Student Activity Fee $360/year on https://www.wellesley.edu/sfs/cost; Health Form deadlines (Jul 1 Fall / Dec 1 Spring) in Wellesley College.docx.

housing_availability.notes: 2026-2027 Factsheet page 2 states: 'Exchange students are required to live in on-campus housing, typically in a double occupancy room ... randomly placed in one of our 15 residence halls' and automatically enrolled in the Wellesley meal plan.

housing_notes.value: Mandatory on-campus furnished residence hall (typically double occupancy) + automatic Wellesley meal plan (4 dining halls); room/board billed per semester ($12,020 housing + $11,186 meals/yr in 2026-2027).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 DS-2019 requires Certification of Finances showing ~$14,000 USD/semester (inclusive of activity fee, housing, meal plan, and health insurance) plus $1,250 USD for books/supplies/personal expenses.

course_catalog_url.notes: Course catalog link embedded on page 3 (also https://www.wellesley.edu/academics/catalog on page 1).

credit_system_and_load.value: Wellesley unit system: 1 Wellesley unit = 4 US credit hours = 7.5 ECTS (~12 hrs/week work); normal full load is 4 classes (~4 units); minimum 3 units required to maintain immigration status and housing.

course_restrictions_note.value: Computer Science courses are NOT open to exchange students; cross-registration limited to max 1 course/semester at MIT, Olin College of Engineering, Babson College, or Brandeis University (MIT UROP excluded; single-semester students strongly encouraged to take all courses at Wellesley).

value: Official transcripts from all previous university coursework (English translation if applicable)
Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL 100 or equivalent, non-native speakers)
required_application_docs.notes: COF on page 2; Health History & Immunization Form in Wellesley College.docx.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory Orientation & Slater International Center J-1 check-in, Class Dean academic advising, and Accessibility & Disability Resources.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall / Full Year: Nomination Feb 15, 2026 / Application Mar 15, 2026; Spring 2027: Nomination Sep 15, 2026 / Application Oct 1, 2026.
